scope: Step3 literature for steps1-4 only; no experiments
resource_constraint: One TITAN RTX24576MiB; no APIs/new data assumed

sources.title: Diffusion-based Adversarial Attack to Automatic Speech Recognition
sources.evidence: DiffVC latent perturbation with a speech-generative prior. Direct predecessor to unrestricted generative/latent ASR search.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: DiffVC latent perturbation with a speech-generative prior. Direct predecessor to unrestricted generative/latent ASR search.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: No attack repo verified; full PDF fetch unsupported.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: No identifiable author attack repository found; DiffVC existence does not supply DAA code. Paper-level competitor; reproduction and 24 GB memory are unproven. Targeted setting differs.

sources.title: SMACK: Semantically Meaningful Adversarial Audio Attack
sources.evidence: Alters inherent speech attributes, including prosody, to preserve human meaning. Direct collision with “noise-free” semantic/prosody novelty.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Alters inherent speech attributes, including prosody, to preserve human meaning. Direct collision with “noise-free” semantic/prosody novelty.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: MIT code; supplementary weights and API-dependent original ASR.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Official MIT code](https://github.com/WUSTL-CSPL/SMACK); supplementary TTS/WaveGlow weights required. Repository ASR routes use Google/iFlytek queries. Its stated 8 GB GPU minimum is not an estimate for the proposed FV pipeline.

sources.title: Whispering Under the Eaves: Protecting User Privacy Against Commercial and LLM-powered Automatic Speech Recognition Systems
sources.evidence: Learns transferable universal perturbations in VITS latent space with target feature adaptation. Closest mandatory collision for latent amortization/universality.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Learns transferable universal perturbations in VITS latent space with target feature adaptation. Closest mandatory collision for latent amortization/universality.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: MIT code; VITS/DeepSpeech2 links; third-party terms separate.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Official MIT code](https://github.com/WeifeiJin/AudioShield) names pretrained VITS/DeepSpeech2 and LibriSpeech dev-clean. Own perturbation must be trained; evaluate local adaptation, not its commercial-API numbers.

sources.title: Boosting the Transferability of Audio Adversarial Examples with Acoustic Representation Optimization
sources.evidence: Adds low-level speech-representation alignment to improve transfer. WavLM auxiliary losses/shared acoustic representation arguments have prior art.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Adds low-level speech-representation alignment to improve transfer. WavLM auxiliary losses/shared acoustic representation arguments have prior art.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: No author code verified.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: No author attack code identified. The targeted feature-alignment loss is not an established untargeted content constraint; adapting it requires an explicit formulation and ablation.

sources.title: Transferable Adversarial Attacks against ASR
sources.evidence: Differentiable front end, momentum/variance time-domain attacks and speech-activity-aware gradient optimization. Strong waveform competitor missing from a generic PGD-only comparison.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Differentiable front end, momentum/variance time-domain attacks and speech-activity-aware gradient optimization. Strong waveform competitor missing from a generic PGD-only comparison.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: No author attack code or checkpoint verified.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Author publication page verified; no code/checkpoint release established. Existing local MI/VMI runs do not establish SAGO parity.

sources.title: Watch What You Pretrain For: Targeted, Transferable Adversarial Examples on Self-Supervised Speech Recognition models
sources.evidence: Demonstrates targeted transfer across SSL-pretrained ASR. Shared SSL features are not by themselves a new transfer mechanism.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Demonstrates targeted transfer across SSL-pretrained ASR. Shared SSL features are not by themselves a new transfer mechanism.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Apache-2.0 code; configs/data; reject target-dependent stopping.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Official Apache-2.0 code](https://github.com/RaphaelOlivier/asr_transferability), attack/model configs and adversarial dataset. Some upstream configurations use another model for stopping: do not import target-dependent stopping into a no-target-query comparison.

sources.title: Imperceptible, Robust, and Targeted Adversarial Examples for Automatic Speech Recognition
sources.evidence: Psychoacoustic masking and simulated environmental robustness; essential established quality-oriented waveform baseline. “IRT” here abbreviates this verified full title.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Psychoacoustic masking and simulated environmental robustness; essential established quality-oriented waveform baseline. “IRT” here abbreviates this verified full title.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Author code linked; exact example/weights license unresolved.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: PMLR links [author code](https://github.com/yaq007/cleverhans/tree/master/examples/adversarial_asr). Original Lingvo/TensorFlow dependencies and model differ; exact example/weight licenses need inspection. Its targeted success is not untargeted transfer WER.

sources.title: Hear "No Evil", See "Kenansville": Efficient and Transferable Black-Box Attacks on Speech Recognition and Voice Identification Systems
sources.evidence: Model-independent spectral deletion gives a signal-processing baseline outside additive small-noise optimization.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Model-independent spectral deletion gives a signal-processing baseline outside additive small-noise optimization.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Author examples verified; original source/license not established.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Author examples verified; no original code license established. RobustSpeech/ART implementations would be separately identified adaptations. Report intelligibility loss, not only ASR error.

sources.title: AdvPulse: Universal, Synchronization-free, and Targeted Audio Adversarial Attacks via Subsecond Perturbations
sources.evidence: Universal subsecond perturbation with time-delay robustness. Strong prior for temporal invariance/universal audio, chiefly command/speaker tasks.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Universal subsecond perturbation with time-delay robustness. Strong prior for temporal invariance/universal audio, chiefly command/speaker tasks.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Author examples; source/weights/license not established.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Author project](https://mosis.eecs.utk.edu/advpulse.html) has examples; attack source/weights/license not established. Not a directly comparable sentence-ASR transfer benchmark.

sources.title: Universal Adversarial Perturbations for Speech Recognition Systems

sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Untargeted universal waveform perturbations and transfer from DeepSpeech to WaveNet.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Original attack repository/license not established.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Paper/examples verified; original attack repository not established. Generic UAP wrappers are not proof of reproduction.

sources.evidence: Single-forward audio perturbation generator and universal generator. A generator alone is an old idea.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Single-forward audio perturbation generator and universal generator. A generator alone is an old idea.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Author generator code/weights not established.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: No author generator weights/code established. Audio-system misclassification setting limits direct sentence-ASR applicability.

sources.title: Muting Whisper: A Universal Acoustic Adversarial Attack on Speech Foundation Models
sources.evidence: Universal short acoustic prefix exploits decoder special tokens.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Universal short acoustic prefix exploits decoder special tokens.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Code/audio segments verified; license not established by README.

sources.title: SlothSpeech: Denial-of-service Attack Against Speech Recognition Models
sources.evidence: Output-token probability attacks on inference latency. WER-only evaluation does not measure its original objective.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Output-token probability attacks on inference latency. WER-only evaluation does not measure its original objective.

sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Official MIT code](https://github.com/0xrutvij/SlothSpeech). No extra attack weights required by basic code; exact model revisions still need pinning.

sources.title: MORE: Multi-Objective Adversarial Attacks on Speech Recognition
sources.evidence: Repulsion on decoded hypotheses followed by EOS suppression/repetition; close decoder-objective prior.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Repulsion on decoded hypotheses followed by EOS suppression/repetition; close decoder-objective prior.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Paper promises code later; repository not verified.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Current paper promises later code release; no author repository verified. Proposed WER-risk objective must be compared with its accuracy stage and avoid counting output-length inflation as sufficient evidence.

sources.title: Codec-Robust Attacks on Audio LLMs
sources.evidence: Continuous EnCodec-latent perturbations plus multi-bitrate straight-through EOT. Direct collision for codec-latent+EOT novelty.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Continuous EnCodec-latent perturbations plus multi-bitrate straight-through EOT. Direct collision for codec-latent+EOT novelty.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Review release; MIT/CC-BY-4.0 only future promise.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: [Paper-linked repository](https://github.com/jrohsc/CodecAttack) exists; README currently describes a review release and only promises MIT code/CC-BY-4.0 data after deanonymization. Large Audio LLMs and some unavailable carriers make full reproduction unsuitable for this 24 GB/local-data project.

sources.title: Generative Testing of Automated Speech Recognition Systems
sources.evidence: Phoneme-level TTS-latent interpolation with semantic/perceptual objectives. Very near local-manifold/content-constrained editing.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Phoneme-level TTS-latent interpolation with semantic/perceptual objectives. Very near local-manifold/content-constrained editing.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: Paper CC-BY4; replication package URL unresolved.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Paper claims anonymized replication package, but usable external package URL not resolved. Query-based search on Whisper-tiny/single-speaker TTS differs from zero-target-query transfer. Its success definition includes any transcript change, so the reported 98% cannot be treated as high WER.

sources.title: Attack-Dependent Robustness of Neural Audio Codecs for Adversarial ASR
sources.evidence: Discrete bottleneck robustness depends on adaptive attack choice; identity-gradient BPDA+EOT can overestimate it relative to RVQ-relaxed attack.
sources.relevance_and_novelty_collision: Discrete bottleneck robustness depends on adaptive attack choice; identity-gradient BPDA+EOT can overestimate it relative to RVQ-relaxed attack.
sources.availability_and_license_caveat: v1 title differs; code/weights not established.
sources.checkpoint_and_comparison_caveat: Search snippets retain v1's different title *Trade-offs Between Capacity and Robustness...*. Use current title/version. Code/checkpoint release not established. Discreteness is neither a guarantee of content preservation nor of robust gradients.

recommendations: R1 bounded lexical N-best sequence risk; EOT independent factor
R2 content-constrained compatible SSL local manifold
R3 input-conditioned waveform Conv-U-Net residual generator; optional matched FV temporal head

representative_queries: Beyond Waveform Robustness exact title github
ASR adversarial semantic prosody codec discrete units 2025 2026
limits: Focused review, not systematic or exhaustive novelty proof
DAA raw PDF endpoint unsupported; abstract/proceedings verified
AMAA unresolved; not treated as a verified method
Unknown licenses/releases are not proven absences

claim_boundary: No SOTA claim or direct transfer of published effect sizes to local results.
